cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let work ring. I've reserved these ten minutes for choosing our wedding vows.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The client won't sign unless I'm there. Can I go?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. I'm about to promise you my whole life; the client may wait while we finish this page.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask Maya to keep him occupied for ten minutes. She'll want a reason.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her you have a prior commitment with me. I approve putting that in your calendar; our promises deserve an appointment too.

reason: A grants only a short holding arrangement rather than departure, using superior time allocation to prioritize vows while making Maya role explicit.
